$comment: Size ceilings for the bundle a browser downloads. Enforced by vite.browser.config.ts on every build:browser, so a breach fails CI. Raising a limit is allowed - record why in its note, in the same change. Bytes, measured on the written file; gzip is node:zlib at level 9, which is not what a CDN serves and does not need to be.

browser.js.note: Raised for the ContentReview family (ContentReview, ReviewSummary, ReviewElement, ReviewMockup, ReviewVersion, CopyField, ReviewScreen), which measured 593,883 raw and 176137 gzip against 532,068 and 158,431 before it. The gzip limit is 176 KiB exactly, because README.md quotes it as the enforced ceiling. Previously set from 4.10.0 at 160 KiB.
